note: Pre-registered BEFORE week-end data arrives. Do not edit thresholds after the fact — edits are regime changes and must be recorded as new versions.

regime_cutoff.rule: FAIL events before this timestamp predate the grammar critic and citation gate. EXCLUDE from the family read; keep only for the trend line.

minimum_sample.rule: If total FAIL events < 20 the read is UNDERPOWERED — extend the window, do not conclude. A family dominating 6 events is noise.

decision.outcome: retrieval-class >= 50% of FAIL events (and min sample met)
compression-class >= 50% of FAIL events (and min sample met)

decision.verdict: Line healthy — no station build justified. Next frontier is throughput: 1.5B draft + 7B target speculative decoding (llama.cpp native; both models already resident).
